No front door

Followers stay followers

Someone can save your recipes for a year and never join an email list. Every day without a class capturing emails is attention you earned and don't get to keep.

No qualifier

Calls start from zero

A follower can go from one reel to a coaching call with no idea how you work or what it costs. A class lets them see your approach first, so the ones who apply already trust it.

Content treadmill

1,300 posts and counting

Growth still leans on the next recipe and the next reel. When you take a week off, the enquiries take a week off too.

The people who love your food but aren't ready for coaching today have no clear next step, so most of them take none.

My recommendation

A $17 masterclass that pays for its own ads and fills your 1:1 coaching

You have the audience and the credentials. What's missing is one paid 60-minute class that teaches your feel-good approach to food and habits, offers a recipe pack on the thank-you page, and invites the right people to apply for coaching. Meta ads then put that class in front of new people every day.

Fixes the missing front door

One class becomes the link in your bio and the destination for your ads. Every buyer is an email you own, and every one of them sees how you think before you ask for anything bigger.

Fixes the missing qualifier

The replay page invites people who want hands-on support to apply. You only talk to people who paid, watched, and told you what they want to change.

Pays for the ads

The $17 seat and the [$37] recipe pack bring money in on the front end, so the ad spend is largely covered before a single coaching client signs.

The 95%*

Not ready for coaching yet

They buy a $17 seat, grab the recipe pack, and keep cooking with you through your emails and posts. They pay you while they build trust, and some come back for your retreat.

The qualified 5%

Ready for hands-on support

They watch to the end and apply on the replay page. The application filters for fit before your calendar, and three pre-call emails warm them up for 1:1.

*The 95% / 5% split is an industry estimate, not your data.

Script 1 · Reel · 30 to 45 seconds

"Don't give up your favourite meal"

Hook
"If eating healthier means giving up your favourite meal, it won't last. Here's what I do instead." (to camera at the table, a plate in front of you, the same look as your profile photo)
Body
"I take the meal you already love and rework it: keep the flavour, add more plants, make it easier on a weeknight. You don't feel deprived, so you keep doing it." (quick cuts of the swap, simple captions)
CTA
"I teach the whole approach in a live 60-minute class called The Feel-Good Kitchen. It's $17 and there's a replay. Tap Sign up. Educational content, not medical advice."
Script 2 · Reel · 30 seconds

"Three questions before you start a new plan"

Hook
"Before you start another new eating plan, ask yourself these three questions." (Alexis holds up three fingers)
Body
"One: would I happily eat this on a busy Wednesday? Two: does it include food I actually love? Three: could I still be doing it in three months? If any answer is no, there's a simpler way." (caption for each question)
CTA
"I show you that simpler way in my $17 masterclass. Link below."
Script 3 · Reel · 45 seconds

"Where to start with my work"

Hook
"People ask me whether to start with my recipes, coaching or my retreat. Here's my honest answer." (in the kitchen, natural light)
Body
"If you're new here, don't pick yet. Come to my class first. You'll cook along, try a few feel-good swaps that week, and know which next step fits you."
CTA
"It's called The Feel-Good Kitchen, it's $17, and there's a replay if you can't make it live. Tap Sign up."
